items.rationale: The topic is the one that costs more, so 오렌지는 comes first. The other side takes 보다: 사과보다. Then 더 and 비싸요. Option a swaps the two sides. Option c puts 보다 as a separate word before the noun. Option d mixes 제일 with 보다.

저는 is the topic, the bigger one. 너보다 means 'than you', with 보다 attached and no space. 더 is optional. 커요 is the sentence form of 크다 and does not change. An answer with 저 and 너 swapped, as in 너는 저보다 더 커요, reverses the sides (M4). An answer that uses 제일 with 보다 shows M3.
A 'the most' sentence puts 제일 or 가장 before the adjective and has no 보다. Option a is a comparative with no second noun and means only 'tastier'. Option b mixes 제일 with 보다 and drops the topic marker.
그는 형보다 제일 빨라요 joins 보다 with 제일. A superlative compares with a whole group and does not pair 보다 with one named thing. The other three sentences follow the pattern Topic + Other보다 + 더 or 덜 + adjective.
남동생은 is the topic. 제일 or 가장 goes right before 빨라요, and there is no 보다. An answer with 더 instead of 제일 shows M5. An answer that adds 보다 shows M3.
